title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-96-24一模

items.zh: 凡今天购买这款手机的顾客可享七折优惠。
items.en: Buy this mobile phone today and you can get a 30% discount.
alt: Whoever buys this mobile phone today can get a 30% discount.

items.zh: 如今网红营销名目繁多，警方提醒公众谨防上当受骗。
items.en: There are now numerous influencer marketing schemes, so the police warn the public to guard against being deceived.

items.zh: 相比其栩栩如生的外表,机器人看家护院的功能是一个更大的卖点。
items.en: Compared with their lifelike appearance, for robots, guarding homes is a bigger selling point.

items.zh: 这个国家不顾人民的安危将废水排入大海，这个行为受到了当地渔民和邻国人民的强烈抗议。
items.en: With much danger to its citizens, the country released waste water into the ocean, which has been strongly protested by local fishermen and people in neighboring countries.
